source_notes.label: Cleaning pressure is not deposition pressure
source_notes.summary: The 3 ×10^-6 Torr value is explicitly attached to laser cleaning before deposition. Deposition gas/pressure remain unreported.

source_notes.label: One film synthesis, multiple measurement conditions
source_notes.summary: FC/ZFC,temperature-dependent hysteresis and MR field sweeps enrich one synthesis outcome. They are not separately prepared nanocrystals.

source_notes.label: The 660 nm film is cited external evidence
source_notes.summary: Figure 3 includes a solid resistance curve from reference 7. Its synthesis, thickness and response are not assigned to the source’s 180 nm film.

source_notes.label: Upper field limit does not establish exact loop closure
source_notes.summary: High-field hysteresis persists through the displayed range: prose places closure only at the 2 T limit, while the Figure 5 caption describes an open loop at 20 kOe. An exact closure field is not established.
